name: SrumECmd
description: Parse SRUDB.dat and export per-application network, energy and resource usage as CSV.
about: The System Resource Usage Monitor database records, roughly hourly, what each application on a Windows system consumed: bytes sent and received per network interface, CPU time, energy use, and which network the machine was connected to at the time. SrumECmd reads SRUDB.dat and writes each of those tables to its own CSV. Supplying the SOFTWARE hive alongside it is optional but recommended, because the interface and user identifiers stored in the database are resolved through that hive into names rather than left as numbers. Given a directory it will locate both files itself.
